_meta.description: Generic effect phrase library for query generation. Slot-level only — no card IDs. Placeholders {amount}, {p}, {t}, {keyword}, {token}, {color} filled at compose time.
_meta.composition_rule: Pick one trigger phrase + one effect phrase + one target phrase per binding. Effect phrases describe the action only; targeting lives in targets.json, numbers in amounts.json.
_meta.card_mapping: Per-card effect bindings live in parsed_cards.jsonl (parser output), not in this library.
